turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Here is one example. I eat an egg. "Egg" starts with a vowel sound, so I use an.
Rule: use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound.
Right: I see a cat. Wrong: I see an cat.
Now you try. Write a or an:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
